class.name: GameLog
class.brief_description: The game's log, as Python's logging: named loggers ([GameLogger]) and the handlers of their lines ([GameLogHandler]). For development-only logs, prefer Godot's built-in functions such as push_error(), push_warning(), print(), and print_rich().
class.description: GameLog is available as an Engine singleton named "GameLog". A logger is taken by its id - [method get_logger] creates a logger missing yet - and kept where a script logs more than once: [codeblock] var _log: GameLogger = GameLog.get_logger("ai") _log.debug("SetVelocity 40") GameLog.get_logger("game").error("Failed to load route") [/codeblock] A line goes at once - nothing is kept in memory - to the handlers registered for the logger's id ([method create_handler]) and to [signal message_logged]. A handler may be registered for an id whose logger does not exist yet: [codeblock] var handler: GameLogFileHandler = GameLogFileHandler.open("user://logs/ai.log") GameLog.create_handler("ai", handler) [/codeblock] The logger "game", of the game's own messages, is made with the log.

method.name: create_handler
method.description: Registers [param handler] for the lines of the logger [param logger_id], which may not exist yet.

method.name: create_logger
method.description: Creates the logger [param logger_id] and emits [signal logger_created]. An error when it exists already.

method.name: get_logger
method.description: The logger [param logger_id], created when it is missing yet (as Python's logging.getLogger()).

method.name: get_loggers
method.description: The ids of the loggers, in the order they were created.

method.name: log
method.description: Logs [param line] at [param loglevel] to the logger [param logger_id] - a shortcut of [code]get_logger(logger_id).log(loglevel, line)[/code].

method.name: remove_handler
method.description: Unregisters [param handler] from the logger [param logger_id].

signal.name: logger_created
signal.description: Emitted when a logger is created.

signal.name: message_logged
signal.description: Emitted for every line of every logger, after its handlers.
